summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/smto_site

src/smto_site/init.py

Python · Tier A

Identify the independent website package.

Responsibilities

  • Expose the website build version.

Boundaries

  • Product runtime versioning remains in its existing owner.

Lifecycle

  • Import only defines a constant.

State

  • The version string is immutable.

Security

  • Import performs no IO or service initialization.

Collaborators

  • app.py supplies the FastAPI factory.

Public surface

  • version identifies the site software.

@see src/smto_site/app.py

src/smto_site/app.py

Python · Tier A

Compose and serve the independent public website.

Responsibilities

  • Build local registries, cached pages, discovery, health and safe error responses.

Boundaries

  • No runtime, Gateway or model provider initialization belongs here.
  • Optional publishing initialization is delegated to smto_site.cms when enabled.

Lifecycle

  • Factory validates core inputs; lifespan tracks readiness; requests select public keys.

State

  • Read-mostly public state is process-local; the optional CMS persists public snapshots.

Security

  • Exact route lookup and dedicated static roots prevent request-selected source reads.

Collaborators

  • ContentRegistry, ReleaseRegistry and Renderer supply public representations.

Public surface

  • create_app supports Uvicorn factory launch and explicit fixture configuration.

@see src/smto_site/content.py

src/smto_site/build_content.py

Python · Tier A

Prepare website links in a checkout; installed websites only read the result.

Details

The explicit publication manifest controls which documents enter the website. Authored manual metadata supplies public document identities and headings, and a separate approved-file list permits repository fallback links. No URLs are fetched. Manual imports are confined to preparation, never ordinary website startup.

src/smto_site/cli.py

Python · Tier A

Launch only the public website after validating configuration.

Responsibilities

  • Map CLI overrides to dedicated site settings and start Uvicorn.

Boundaries

  • No other service, browser or dependency installer is started.

Lifecycle

  • Parse arguments, validate, then let Uvicorn own signal handling.

State

  • Only explicit SMTO_SITE environment overrides change in this process.

Security

  • Default loopback bind; reload is forbidden in production; proxy headers are untrusted.

Collaborators

  • config.py validates settings and app.py supplies the ASGI factory.

Public surface

  • main is the installed smto-site entry point.

@see scripts/start-smto-site.sh

src/smto_site/cms/migrations/0003_websitepage_homepage_site_copy_seedbinding.py

Python · Tier A

Extend CMS storage with website pages, shared wording and stable seed identities. Django applies the frozen WebsitePage and SeedBinding schemas after migration 0002. A small database default adds HomePage.site_copy, while migration state retains the full editor schema; initialize_copy fills only that new field on existing rows. Historical revisions are not rewritten. RunPython has a no-op reverse; database errors propagate to Django. Preserve the frozen field payloads and dependencies when maintaining explanations in this applied migration.

Python · Tier A

Validate explicit public website configuration.

Responsibilities

  • Parse typed SMTO_SITE settings and reject unsafe deployment origins.

Boundaries

  • Never reuse runtime credentials or infer a public repository URL.

Lifecycle

State

Security

  • HTTPS URL, contact and reload rules fail closed.

Collaborators

  • cli.py starts the listener; releases.py shares the public URL policy.

Public surface

  • SiteConfig and public_url validate deployment and metadata inputs.

@see src/smto_site/cli.py

src/smto_site/container.py

Python · Tier A

Supervise the website and canonical manual in one Docker container.

Responsibilities

Start both listeners, check combined health, and propagate lifecycle signals.

Boundaries

Used only as the image CMD; explicit maintenance commands bypass the supervisor.

Lifecycle

Either child exiting stops its sibling and fails the container; signals stop both.

State

Child process handles only; database and CMS storage remain owned by the website.

Security

Listeners use fixed internal ports; Docker controls the published host bindings.

Collaborators

smto_site.cli and manual.cli retain ownership of their respective applications.

Public surface

main serves both processes or runs --healthcheck for Docker.

@see packaging/site/docker-compose.yml

Symbol Line Documentation
